THIS ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENT ANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT("Agreement") made as of the  day of December, 2006 by and between CHUN-BONG LEE, INC., a New York corporation ("Lower Parcel Owner"), having an address c/o Giovanniello & Co., 100 MerrickRoad,Suite206W,RockvilleCenter,NewYork11570andEXTELLDIAMOND TOWER LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Developer"), having an address c/o Extell Development Company, 800 Third Ave., Fourth Floor, New York, NY 10022. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Lower Parcel Owner is the owner in fee of certain land,with the buildings and improvements thereon, which land and improvements lie below a horizontal plane (the “Upper Horizontal Plane") drawn at an elevation of one hundred thirty (130) feet above the datum used by the Topographic Bureau of the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan (which is 2.75 feet above the United States Coast and Geodetic Survey mean sea level datum,Sandy Hook, New Jersey) ("Manhattan Datum"), located in the Borough of Manhattan, County, City and State of NewYork,known as Tax Lot 19 in Block 1262 on the Tax Map of the City, County, and State of New York (the “Tax Map"), known and numbered as 39 West 46"h Street, New York, New York (said land being called the “Lower Parcel Land", as more particularly described with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to this Agreement being called the "Lower Parcel Building", and the Lower Parcel Land and the Lower Parcel Building being herein collectively called the “Lower Premises"; WHEREAS,Developer acquired from the Lower Parcel Owner by deed (the “Airspace Deed") dated of even date herewith the volume of air which lies above the Upper Horizontal Plane, located within the boundaries of the Lower Parcel Land (as more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof, being herein called the “Airspace Premises"), so that on the date hereof Lower Parcel Owner is the owner in fee of the Lower Premises and Developer is the owner infee of theAirspacePremises; WHEREAS,by execution of a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions of even date and contemporaneously herewith (the“Declaration"), Lower Parcel Owner and Developer have utilized the procedure available pursuant to Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution to confirmthat theLowerParcelLandandtheAirspacePremisescontinuetocompriseasingle zoning lot, which zoning lot may be enlarged or subdivided in accordance with the terms of this Agreement (the“Combined Zoning Lot"),for the purpose of making available the Excess Floor Area Development Rights for utilization in connection with the construction of the New Developer Building; Zoning Resolution) to the Combined Zoning Lot, as shown on the Zoning Lot Certification of Commonwealth Land Title Insurance Company (Certification"), annexed hereto as Exhibit E, to waive their right to execute any Declarations relating to any future expansion of the Combined ZoningLotand tosubordinate theirrespectiveinterest tothisAgreement,asamended,by execution of a Waiver of Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions and Subordination to Zoning Lot Development Agreement;
